assay: bulk RNA-seq, human vastus lateralis biopsies (S4.6.1.p1)
primary_estimand: Difference in muscle gene expression between non-dialysis CKD patients and healthy age-matched controls (disease state, associational); secondary: CKD pre- vs post-dialysis initiation. No exercise intervention or exercise arm exists; both groups were 'highly sedentary' (S2.1.p1).
sample_inclusion: 7 CKD, 7 control (S2.5.p1); 4 dialysis samples, 3 paired with prior CKD biopsy, 1 unpaired (S2.6.p3)
repeated_measure_unit: patient (sample ID used as blocking variable for paired CKD/dialysis, S4.6.2.p2)
planned_contrasts: CKD vs Control (S2.5.p1; paper: 967 DEGs, 464 up / 503 down, q < 0.05)
Dialysis vs CKD pre-dialysis (S2.6.p3; paper: 0 DEGs, q < 0.05)
paper_method: edgeR TMM + limma-voom, CPM > 0.5 in >= 7 samples, patient as blocking variable, eBayes, BH q < 0.05 (S4.6.2.p2)
exercise_content: Exercise mentioned only as background (S2.3.p1, S3.p8 citing other studies); physical function tests (strength, endurance) are outcomes, not interventions.
